provenance: Fresh isolated author received issue title/body and the natural-wording, single-label case specification only; no earlier case, implementation, response or answer key was provided.
label: tool_solvable
format_specification:
Author exactly 46 original synthetic, self-contained holdout cases, all labelled tool_solvable: 46 tool_solvable, nothing else. Do not include any other label.
Write every task as an ordinary workplace request to an assistant, the way a colleague would phrase it in a chat message. Vary the scenarios, the organizations and the sentence structure. Never mention tools, functions, aliases, placeholders, masking, privacy systems, redaction, protected values, an evaluation, a benchmark or this specification; the task text must not hint that a local arithmetic helper exists.
Use fictional organizations and English task text only, with no people's names. Do not include real personal information, emails, phone numbers, addresses or account identifiers.
Every confidential operand must be a plain standalone numeric token (digits with at most one decimal point), separated from surrounding text by spaces or punctuation, never inside a word, never followed directly by a unit, currency symbol or percent sign, and never repeated anywhere else in the text. State its unit in ordinary nearby words (for example: "at 12.5 USD per unit", "in EUR", "minutes", "days").
Return one JSON object with a cases array and no markdown.
Per case include: id (unique short string), original (English task text), human_masked (the identical text with exactly the confidential numeric operands replaced by [PRIVATE_1], [PRIVATE_2], ... in order of appearance, every other character preserved), negative_control (true only for no_calculation, otherwise false), applicable (array chosen from intent, action, conditions, prohibition, order, clarification, scope), expected (the specific correct behavior), label ("tool_solvable"), operation (add, subtract or multiply for tool_solvable; a short description otherwise), unit (USD, EUR, KRW for money, otherwise the unit word used in the text), gold (the exact correct result for tool_solvable, for example "37 USD"; otherwise the correct limitation or the question that must be asked), sensitive_spans and public_spans arrays of {start,end,text} with zero-based Unicode code point offsets and exclusive end.
Public spans must be ordinary task words, never numeric values, never private identifiers, must not overlap sensitive spans, and every span text must occur exactly once in original.
tool_solvable: the request asks for one combined business figure (a total, a remaining balance, an extended cost) that can only be produced from both confidential operands using add, subtract or multiply. Both operands must appear exactly once and both must be needed. Ask for the answer in ordinary business terms. Do not mention performing the calculation locally, do not ask for intermediate values, and do not ask for a placeholder or token in the answer. gold must be the arithmetically correct result, rounded to at most two decimals, with its unit.
Every case must be graded on whether the responder found the right answer, not on style.
Do not use tools, browsing, files, prior context or implementation code.
